inspiration.observed_pattern: An existing child table receives a named foreign-key constraint with ON DELETE CASCADE through ALTER TABLE.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored manifest and one item. The ALTER adds the named cascade constraint, then deleting the parent isolates the foreign-key enforcement and cascade behavior.

fixture_notes: One valid manifest/item pair isolates the added constraint and verifies that deleting the parent cascades to the child.
determinism_notes: The single fixed parent and child use deterministic IDs; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE manifest_min (manifest_id INT PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE item_min (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, manifest_id INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: ALTER TABLE item_min ADD CONSTRAINT fk_item_min_manifest FOREIGN KEY (manifest_id) REFERENCES manifest_min (manifest_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

checks.sql: SELECT manifest_id FROM manifest_min ORDER BY manifest_id
SELECT item_id, manifest_id FROM item_min ORDER BY item_id
